content: Presence of each parent-fund holding in an ESG fund of the same market: SPY vs ESGV; XIU vs XCSR (ESG Leaders) and XESG (ESG Focus)

content: Reported financials per company, metric, period and filing (revenue, profit, EPS, cash flow, balance sheet)
source: SEC EDGAR XBRL company facts: 10-K / 10-Q (us-gaap) and 40-F / 6-K (us-gaap or ifrs-full) filings
coverage: 18 SEC filers of the universe: RY, TD, MFC, ENB, CNQ, CNR (Canadian National, SEC ticker CNI), FTS, SHOP and AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, AMZN, TSLA, JPM, JNJ, PG, XOM (Exxon Mobil Corp, CIK 34088); facts filed from 2019-01-23 to 2026-11-06
frequency: Annual and quarterly (point-in-time: one row per filing)
currency: Reporting currency of each company (USD or CAD), never converted
processing: scripts/ingest_fundamentals.py (CIKs from scripts/sec_cik.py): full-year (annual forms) and stand-alone quarter durations and balance-sheet instants; year-to-date figures dropped; first available tag per metric (us-gaap, then ifrs-full); every filing kept with its filed date
limitations: No data for non-SEC filers (ATD, CSU); banks and insurers have no gross profit or capex and are not comparable with industrials; fiscal years are not calendar-aligned; no valuation multiples; ticker-to-company mapping is checked through scripts/sec_cik.py (SEC ticker CNR is Core Natural Resources, XOM moved to a new holding company)
terms_of_use: SEC EDGAR: public domain; send a contact e-mail in the User-Agent, at most 10 requests per second

content: Dated news events: SEC 8-K filings (with an excerpt of the filing's text), central bank rate decisions
source: SEC EDGAR submissions and 8-K primary documents (public domain); Bank of Canada / FRED (derived from curated/macro_pit.csv)
coverage: 8-K: 2021-11-12 to 2026-11-12 for 17 SEC filers (485 events, 481 with item text); rate decisions 2022-03-02 to 2026-10-28; press headlines (GDELT) dropped on 2026-11-15: 6 days only and noisy
processing: scripts/ingest_news.py keeps 8-Ks with material items (1.01, 1.03, 1.05, 2.01, 2.02, 2.05, 2.06, 3.01, 4.02, 5.02, 8.01); scripts/enrich_8k.py reads the primary document and keeps the item text (about 700 characters, standard headings removed, never the full filing); an 8-K whose body only refers to exhibits gets a one-line note; event published_at = SEC filing date; indexed in the Bedrock Knowledge Base alphaforge-news-docs (Titan Text Embeddings v2, S3 Vectors) by scripts/deploy_news_kb.py with a published_date <= as_of metadata filter
limitations: Excerpt = first ~700 characters of the item: the filing may say more; a results 8-K (2.02) carries no figures (see fundamentals.csv); exhibits (press releases) are not read; Canadian National files 40-F / 6-K and has no 8-K; ATD and CSU do not file with the SEC; press is one week deep, unreviewed and noisy; corpus is incomplete, so no match is not proof that nothing happened
terms_of_use: SEC EDGAR: public domain, 10 requests per second, contact e-mail in the User-Agent; GDELT: titles and links only, one request per 5 seconds
